compiler_spec.scope: No CALL, RETURN, prototype, spacebase, or mapped-symbol edge is present; the compiler-model state is not part of the covered width projection. Its full-state mismatch is retained below.

analysis_options.raw_output_normalization: none; each side has an independent pinned stdout SHA-256
analysis_options.covered_projection: Only the six explicitly enumerated raw array-versus-unknown tokens are translated before requiring complete record equality; this does not change overall_status=MISMATCH

input_manifest.canonicalization: SHA-256 of sorted compact JSON over architecture, compiler_spec, analysis_options, graph, and cases

graph.function: real Funcdata with type recovery started
graph.block: one real BlockBasic containing all six live ops in declared order
graph.source: one shared 8-byte register Varnode, INPUT|TYPELOCK, canonical ProgressData(32)*
graph.progress_datatype: one 32-byte ProgressData-shaped object per side with field pointee/offset layout total@0:int8, prev@8:int8, point@16:int8, width@24:int4; only size and pointee identity participate in the covered projection, while completion and TypeField ident representation remain MISMATCH
graph.space_operands: six distinct 4-byte constant Varnodes encoding ram space id 3
graph.targets: six pairwise-distinct production Varnodes; LOAD targets are written outputs, STORE targets are free input2 values
graph.alias_topology: source is the identical input1 object of every op; every op, space operand, and target is distinct; slot, def, descendant, parent-block, and alive relationships are asserted after both passes

observation_schema.pre_exception_state: The pre record is flushed before Action execution and contains every target type, raw metatype, object identity, block/descendant order, source identity/flags/descendant count, and topology verdict
observation_schema.return_and_exception: Both successful apply return values are observed; injected exception identity and phase are explicitly UNTESTED
observation_schema.type_and_identity: Normalized class, raw metatype, size, identity against the original target type, and identity against ProgressData
observation_schema.mutation: Source type/flags, each target's primary and named propagation flags, op alive state, def links, descendants, slots, parent block, and actual current block/descendant order
observation_schema.iteration: Declared op order and two sequential Action applies; pass2 requires exact pass1 datatype identity stability

comparand.source_policy: An externally supplied full candidate commit OID anchors the exact six-file diff. The runner materializes every evidence file from candidate Git blobs, archives the pinned Rugra base, overlays only candidate src/coreaction.rs, and executes only run-private snapshots with pre/post Git-object readback.

candidate_evidence.external_anchor: full candidate commit/tree and six blob OIDs recorded by independent review; metadata is not self-authenticating
candidate_evidence.materialization: git cat-file blobs into a private home-backed snapshot followed by fixed-FD self-exec

load_store_value_to_pointer_factory_word.detail: ACTION-INFERTYPES-DISPATCH-0001: reverse propagation still constructs a fresh pointer with hard-coded wordsize 1 and alt-type width

compiler_model_and_architecture_full_sta.detail: ACTION-INFERTYPES-DISPATCH-0001: the synthetic hosts expose only the state consumed by these LOAD/STORE edges; Ghidra owns an empty ProtoModel while Rugra has none

progress_struct_field_identity.detail: TYPEFIELD-IDENT-REPRESENTATION-0001: locked Ghidra TypeField carries ident values 0,1,2,3 while Rugra TypeField has no corresponding identity member

variable_length_pointee.detail: ACTION-INFERTYPES-DISPATCH-0001: not part of the fixed ProgressData input

plain_enum_partial_piece.detail: TYPEFACTORY-EXACTPIECE-0001: canonical getExactPiece owner API is a separate dependency

relative_pointer_enum_exact_piece.detail: TYPEFACTORY-EXACTPIECE-0001: relative exact-piece propagation is fail-closed until the factory dependency lands

ptrsub_downchain_pointerrel_and_stop_fla.detail: ACTION-INFERTYPES-DISPATCH-0001; explicitly excluded from this slice
